name: LockedTokenGuildConsensus

methods.name: configure
methods.desc: Re-point the policy at another staking app, asset, or approval floor while the Guild is in draft.

methods.name: consensusActionMbr
methods.desc: Quote and validate an opaque consensus action; unsupported codes are rejected.

methods.name: applyConsensusAction
methods.desc:
Apply an approved Guild consensus action; direct accounts cannot call this route.

A new approval floor may not exceed the approvals of the proposal that sets it, so a Guild can
never raise its floor beyond what its own voters just demonstrated and lock itself out.

methods.name: bindGuild
methods.desc: Permanently bind this consensus instance to the Guild created beside it.

methods.name: cleanupBallot
methods.desc: Delete terminal vote receipts in batches, then delete the empty ballot and refund its MBR to the Guild.

methods.name: hasVoted
methods.desc: Whether `voter` has a vote on the proposal (a further vote changes it).

desc:
Time-weighted governance for universal-staking locks that outlive the ballot.

Power is measured in whole-token-years: a lock of one whole token (10^decimals base units) with a
year remaining carries one unit of power, whatever the asset's decimals.

Aggregate locked supply is mutable and therefore never used as a quorum denominator;
instead every ballot carries an absolute approval floor (`minimumApprovals`) so a lone
small lock can never pass a proposal in an empty room.

staking.desc: universal staking application used to resolve voting power

votingAsset.desc: asset whose live locked stake grants voting power

minimumApprovals.desc: minimum absolute approval power required for any proposal to pass

votingUnit.desc: base units in one whole voting token (10^decimals)

guild.desc: Guild permanently paired with this consensus application

activeBallots.desc: number of proposals with an open ballot

activated.desc: whether the paired Guild has left draft; settings are re-validated on policy changes afterwards

ballots.desc: ballot state keyed by Guild proposal ID

votes.desc: individual vote receipts keyed by proposal ID and voter
